events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small streams flooding caused by upstream
dam release continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring. Low-water crossings are
inundated with water and may not be passable. Flooding of low water
crossings across the Salt River downstream of Tempe Town Lake is
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1248 PM MST, dam operators reported water release from Tempe
Town Lake. Flooding due to a dam floodgate release will continue.
A few streamflow gauges downstream from Tempe Town Lake were
reporting flows around 500-1500 cfs.
- Flooding is occurring along the Salt River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Phoenix, Laveen, and Avondale.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by upstream dam releases continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Salt River below Granite Reef Dam is
occurring. Flooding of low water crossings across the Salt River
upstream of Tempe Town Lake, including McKellips Road, is
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1241 PM MST, Latest update from dam operators, around 2:45 AM
MST this morning, reported 2600 cfs was being released from
Granite Reef Dam. Flooding due to a dam floodgate release will
continue.
- Flooding is occurring along the Salt River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Salt River between Granite Reef Dam and Tempe Town Lake.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
